raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly stated that the foundation behind the Free Software Directory was the Wikimedia Foundation (founded by Jimmy Wales), conflating unrelated entities. The Free Software Directory is a project of the Free Software Foundation, which was founded by Richard Stallman. This misattribution likely arose from misreading a search snippet and mixing up FSF with Wikimedia/Wikipedia.
